import sys,importlib.util,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('review_convergence',p);e=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(e);sys.modules['review_convergence']=e
print(json.dumps({'module_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'mutation':sys.argv[3]}),flush=True)
if sys.argv[3]=='directory-accepted':
 original=e.read_bytes
 e.read_bytes=lambda p,*a,**kw: b'directory-not-rejected' if str(p)=='.' else original(p,*a,**kw)
normal,body=sys.argv[2],sys.argv[4];sys.argv=['probe',normal];exec(body)

import resource,sys
import review_convergence as e
soft,hard=resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE)
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE,(min(64,soft),hard))
rejected=0
for _ in range(80):
    try:e.read_bytes('.')
    except e.DataError:rejected+=1
assert rejected == 80, 'directory rejection was not exercised'
assert e.read_bytes(sys.argv[1]) == b'fixed-payload'
